PDF.js browser module and worker
Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js and npm package pdfjs-dist@6.5.438
Files: build/pdf.min.mjs and build/pdf.worker.min.mjs (renamed locally).
License: Apache License 2.0, see PDFJS-LICENSE.txt.
Security maintenance: These files are vendored and are not covered by npm audit.
Monitor upstream PDF.js security advisories and update both files together.
The renderer disables eval support and loads document data locally.
